verdict.rationale: Orrick's Tech Studio provides formation-related forms (e.g., a Germany Incorporation Questionnaire) and community evidence confirms Delaware C-corp incorporation support, plus the firm has offices/practices in UK, Germany, India and other markets, suggesting jurisdictional reach. However, there is no direct evidence of published guidance comparing entity types or advising which jurisdiction/entity (Delaware C-corp vs UK Ltd vs GmbH/UG vs Indian Pvt Ltd) fits a founder's market. missing for 10: explicit comparative guidance content on entity type/jurisdiction choice, UK/India-specific incorporation forms or questionnaires, first-party articles addressing cross-jurisdiction tradeoffs.
